from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = []


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            status, payload = r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {status} (expected {expect}): {payload}")
        print(f"  FAIL {method} {path} -> {status} expected {expect}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        failures.append(msg)
        print("  FAIL", msg)
    else:
        print("  ok  ", msg)


def iso(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = p["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, token=tok, expect=200)
    return tok, p["data"]["userId"]


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    print("== readiness / auth")
    st, p = call("GET", "/ready", expect=200)
    check(p.get("status") == "ready", "ready endpoint")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "wrong"}, expect=401)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_credentials", "invalid credentials rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns admin role")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token="nope", expect=401)

    print("== sample types")
    st, snap = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-sample-type", {"name": f"Probe-{suffix}", "containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "qualifiedCollectorRequired": True, "requiredQualification": f"probe-{suffix}"}, token=admin, expect=201)
    probe_type = p["data"]["sampleTypeId"]
    check(p["data"]["batchingAllowed"] is True, "sample type defaults batchingAllowed")

    print("== network")
    def loc(name, lat, lon, fns, handling=5):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lon}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["locationId"]
    cp = loc(f"CP-{suffix}", 52.5200, 13.4050, ["collection_point"])
    hub = loc(f"Hub-{suffix}", 52.5300, 13.4200, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = loc(f"Lab-{suffix}", 52.5400, 13.4400, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = loc(f"Lab2-{suffix}", 52.5100, 13.3800, ["laboratory"])
    for rid in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": rid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
    def conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": 1, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, token=admin, expect=201)
        cid = p["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
        return cid
    c1 = conn(cp, hub, 20)
    c2 = conn(hub, lab, 20)
    c3 = conn(cp, lab2, 60)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab2, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, snap2 = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(snap2["data"]["version"] > snap["data"]["version"], "serviceability version advanced after network change")
    check(snap2["data"]["status"] == "complete", "snapshot is complete")

    print("== users")
    def user(name, roles, quals=None, assigned=None):
        body = {"username": f"{name}-{suffix}", "initialPassword": "pw12345", "fullName": name, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        if quals:
            body["qualifications"] = quals
            body["certifications"] = [{"code": q, "active": True} for q in quals]
        if assigned:
            body["assignedLocationId"] = assigned
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", body, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["userId"]
    req_id = user("requester", ["requester"])
    col_id = user("collector", ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], [f"probe-{suffix}"])
    cour_id = user("courier", ["delivery_partner"])
    cour2_id = user("courier2", ["delivery_partner"])
    cp_handler_id = user("cphandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=cp)
    hub_handler_id = user("hubhandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=hub)
    lab_op_id = user("labop", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab)
    lab2_op_id = user("lab2op", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab2)
    disp_id = user("dispatcher", ["dispatcher"])
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": f"requester-{suffix}", "initialPassword": "x", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, token=admin, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "username_exists", "duplicate username rejected")

    requester, _ = login(f"requester-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    collector, _ = login(f"collector-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=collector, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is True, "multi-role user must select a role")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_selected", "role_not_selected before selection")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, token=collector, expect=403)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_held", "cannot select unheld role")
    call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "collection_professional"}, token=collector, expect=200)
    courier, _ = login(f"courier-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    courier2, _ = login(f"courier2-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    cp_handler, _ = login(f"cphandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    hub_handler, _ = login(f"hubhandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    lab_op, _ = login(f"labop-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    dispatcher, _ = login(f"dispatcher-{suffix}", "pw12345")

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    deadline = now + timedelta(hours=6)
    body = {"origin": {"latitude": 52.5210, "longitude": 13.4060}, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(deadline)}
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", body, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is True and p["data"]["reason"] == "serviceable", "home near CP is serviceable")
    check(p["data"].get("targetLaboratoryId") == lab, "fastest lab chosen")
    far = dict(body, origin={"latitude": 53.9, "longitude": 10.0})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", far, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is False and p["data"]["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage", "far origin outside coverage")
    tight = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=10)))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", tight, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", "tight deadline unreachable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now - timedelta(hours=1))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_deadline", "deadline in the past rejected")
    st, before = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(len(before["data"]["pending"]) + len(before["data"]["inProgress"]) == 0, "dry run created nothing")

    print("== collection request")
    body.update({"containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "earliestCollectionAt": iso(now), "latestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=2))})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", body, token=requester, expect=201)
    sample_id = p["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = p["data"]["journeyId"]
    check(p["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable", "request serviceable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="bag"), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "handling_mismatch", "container mismatch rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, earliestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(hours=3))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_collection_window", "inverted collection window rejected")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["state"]["status"] == "requested", "sample requested")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
    plan = p["data"]
    check(plan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(plan["legs"]) == 3, f"3 transport legs, mode {plan['routeMode']}")
    check(len(plan["nodeAssignmentIds"]) == 2 and len(plan["laboratoryAssignmentIds"]) == 1, "node and lab assignments created")
    collection_asg = plan["collectionAssignmentId"]
    leg1, leg2, leg3 = [l["assignmentId"] for l in plan["legs"]]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check("legs" in p["data"] and "workerId" not in json.dumps(p["data"]["legs"]), "requester view hides workers")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=courier2, expect=403)

    print("== offers / accept / decline")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=collector, expect=200)
    check(any(w["assignmentId"] == collection_asg for w in p["data"]["pending"]), "collector sees offered collection")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=courier, expect=403)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg}, token=collector, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_required", "idempotency key required")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    st, p2 = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p == p2, "idempotent replay returns same result")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_conflict", "same key different body conflicts")
    st, w1 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier, expect=200)
    st, w2 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier2, expect=200)
    offered_c1 = [w["assignmentId"] for w in w1["data"]["pending"]]
    offered_c2 = [w["assignmentId"] for w in w2["data"]["pending"]]
    check(not (set(offered_c1) & set(offered_c2)), "an offer goes to one worker at a time")
    check(len(offered_c1) + len(offered_c2) >= 3, f"all legs offered ({len(offered_c1)}+{len(offered_c2)})")
    holder_of = {}
    for aid in (leg1, leg2, leg3):
        if aid in offered_c1:
            holder_of[aid] = (courier, cour_id)
        elif aid in offered_c2:
            holder_of[aid] = (courier2, cour2_id)
    tok, uid = holder_of[leg1]
    other_tok, other_uid = (courier2, cour2_id) if tok == courier else (courier, cour_id)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/decline-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "d1", "reason": "busy"}, token=tok, expect=201)
    check(p["data"].get("reofferedTo") == other_uid, "declined offer re-offered to next worker")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "a-leg1"}, token=tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "offer_not_offered", "decliner cannot accept re-offered work")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "a-leg1"}, token=other_tok, expect=201)
    leg1_tok, leg1_uid = other_tok, other_uid
    for aid in (leg2, leg3):
        tok, uid = holder_of[aid]
        call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": aid, "idempotencyKey": "a-" + aid}, token=tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    cp_asg = p["data"]["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    check(p["data"]["pending"][0]["nodeId"] == cp, "cp handler offered its node assignment")
    check("destinationCapacity" in p["data"]["pending"][0], "node work item shows capacity")
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": cp_asg, "idempotencyKey": "a-cp"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=hub_handler, expect=200)
    hub_asg = p["data"]["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": hub_asg, "idempotencyKey": "a-hub"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=lab_op, expect=200)
    lab_asg = p["data"]["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    check(p["data"]["pending"][0].get("expectedSampleTypeId") == probe_type, "lab sees expected sample type")
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": lab_asg, "idempotencyKey": "a-lab"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)

    print("== collection and sealing")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(now), "idempotencyKey": "pu-early"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "collection_required", "pickup before collection rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "collectedAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=3)), "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 4, "idempotencyKey": "c-late"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "outside_collection_window", "collection outside window rejected")
    t_collect = now + timedelta(minutes=5)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "collectedAt": iso(t_collect), "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 4, "idempotencyKey": "c1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "sealed" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sample sealed, collector holds it")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.521, "longitude": 13.406}, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, token=collector, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.521, "longitude": 13.406}, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, token=collector, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_sequence", "repeated location sequence rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 5, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=1)), "idempotencyKey": "cp1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["compliant"] is True, "compliant checkpoint")

    print("== handoff collector -> courier")
    t = t_collect + timedelta(minutes=10)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": collection_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": holder_of[leg2][1], "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h-bad"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "nonadjacent_handoff", "skipping a leg is rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": collection_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg1, "receiverId": leg1_uid, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    h1 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sender still holds until both confirm")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1r"}, token=collector, expect=403)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1r"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "pending" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "one side confirmed: still pending")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1s"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "confirmed" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid, "both confirmed: courier holds")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1s-again"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid, "repeated confirmation does not duplicate custody")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid and p["data"]["status"] == "in_transit", "lifecycle shows holder & status")

    print("== transport to CP, hub, lab")
    t += timedelta(minutes=15)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p1"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=5)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p2"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p3"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_transition", "backwards progress rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": hub_asg, "receiverId": hub_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h-wrongnode"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") in ("nonadjacent_handoff", "node_assignment_mismatch", "transport_leg_incomplete"), "handoff to wrong node rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": cp_asg, "receiverId": cp_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    h2 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2s"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2r"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id, "cp handler holds sample")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=leg1_tok, expect=200)
    check(any(w["assignmentId"] == leg1 for w in p["data"]["completed"]), "completed leg visible as past work")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=dispatcher, expect=200)
    smp = [s for s in p["data"]["samples"] if s["sampleId"] == sample_id][0]
    check(smp["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id, "operations state shows holder")
    t += timedelta(minutes=10)
    tok2, uid2 = holder_of[leg2]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": cp_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": uid2, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    h3 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3s"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3r"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=20)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p4"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg2, "toAssignmentId": hub_asg, "receiverId": hub_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    h4 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4s"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4r"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": hub_asg, "locationId": hub, "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 15, "recordedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "cp2"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["compliant"] is False and p["data"]["sampleStatus"] == "exception", "non-compliant checkpoint flags exception")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(p["data"].get("exception", {}).get("reason") == "handling_noncompliant", "lifecycle shows exception")
    t += timedelta(minutes=10)
    tok3, uid3 = holder_of[leg3]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": hub_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg3, "receiverId": uid3, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    h5 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h5, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5s"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h5, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5r"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=20)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r-early"}, token=lab_op, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "receipt_not_ready", "receipt before handoff rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg3, "toAssignmentId": lab_asg, "receiverId": lab_op_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    h6 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h6, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6s"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h6, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6r"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab2, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r-wrong"}, token=lab_op, expect=403)
    check(p.get("code") == "wrong_laboratory_operator", "operator of another lab rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r1"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "received", "sample received")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "completed", "journey completed")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=requester, expect=200)
    actions = [e["action"] for e in p["data"]["timeline"]]
    check("custody.transferred" in actions and "sample.received" in actions, "timeline has custody and receipt")
    check(all(p["data"]["timeline"][i]["eventId"] < p["data"]["timeline"][i + 1]["eventId"] for i in range(len(actions) - 1)), "timeline ordered")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    labloc = [l for l in p["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == lab][0]
    check(labloc["capacity"]["reservedUnits"] == 0, "capacity released after receipt")

    print("== audit")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample_id, "limit": 10, "order": "oldest_first"}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["total"] > 10 and p["data"]["hasMore"] is True and p["data"]["returned"] == 10, "audit search pages")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"action": "auth.login"}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["total"] >= 5, "sign-ins audited")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"limit": 0}, token=admin, expect=400)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {}, token=requester, expect=403)

    print("== pre-sealed registration at a node")
    body2 = dict(body, originType="node", originNodeId=cp, origin={"latitude": 52.52, "longitude": 13.405}, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(hours=8)))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/ingest-presealed-sample", body2, token=hub_handler, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_holder", "node handler must register at own node")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/ingest-presealed-sample", body2, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["alreadySealed"] is True, "presealed registered")
    ps_id, ps_j = p["data"]["sampleId"], p["data"]["journeyId"]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": ps_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(len(p["data"]["legs"]) == 2 and not p["data"]["collectionAssignmentIds"], "presealed journey has only onward legs")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": ps_id}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id and p["data"]["sealed"], "registrant holds presealed sample")

    print("== dispatcher: reroute / disruption / cancel / plan versions")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/reroute-journey", {"journeyId": ps_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 99, "idempotencyKey": "rr0"}, token=dispatcher, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "stale_plan", "stale plan version rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/reroute-journey", {"journeyId": ps_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "idempotencyKey": "rr1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["replanStatus"] == "not_required", "reroute with unchanged network not required")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/report-disruption", {"resourceType": "node", "resourceId": hub, "occurredAt": iso(t), "reason": "flood", "idempotencyKey": "dis1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["replanStatus"] == "replaced" and ps_id in p["data"]["affectedSampleIds"], f"hub disruption replans: {p['data']['replanStatus']}")
    new_j = p["data"]["replacementPlanIds"][0] if p["data"]["replacementPlanIds"] else None
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": new_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"].get("parentJourneyId") == ps_j and p["data"]["legs"][0]["toLocationId"] == lab2, "replacement journey goes to lab2")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": ps_id}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id and p["data"]["activeJourneyId"] == new_j, "holder unchanged after replanning")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": ps_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "replaced" and p["data"].get("replacementJourney", {}).get("journeyId") == new_j, "old journey marked replaced")
    call("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {"locationId": hub, "active": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/cancel-journey", {"journeyId": new_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "idempotencyKey": "cx1", "reason": "test"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "cancelled", "journey cancelled")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{ps_id}", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["state"]["status"] == "cancelled", "sample cancelled")

    print("== merge / split")
    reqs = []
    for i in range(2):
        b = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(hours=8)))
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", b, token=requester, expect=201)
        reqs.append((p["data"]["sampleId"], p["data"]["journeyId"]))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/merge-journeys", {"targetJourneyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "sourceJourneyIds": [reqs[1][1]], "idempotencyKey": "m1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"].get("routeMode") == "batched" and set(p["data"].get("sampleIds", [])) == {reqs[0][0], reqs[1][0]}, "journeys merged into a batch")
    merged_version = p["data"].get("planVersion", 2)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/split-journey", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version, "sampleIds": [reqs[1][0]], "idempotencyKey": "s1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["splitJourney"]["sampleIds"] == [reqs[1][0]] and p["data"]["journey"]["sampleIds"] == [reqs[0][0]], "batch split back apart")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/edit-active-plan", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version + 1, "changeType": "remove_stop", "changes": {"stopId": "nope"}, "idempotencyKey": "e1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_stop", "invalid stop edit rejected and plan kept")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/edit-active-plan", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version + 1, "changeType": "bogus", "changes": {}, "idempotencyKey": "e2"}, token=dispatcher, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_change_type", "invalid change type rejected")

    print("== events")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/events?since=0", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["cursor"] > 0 and len(p["data"]["events"]) > 0, "events replay via since cursor")

    print("== capacity guard")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cp, "capacityUnits": 0, "cooledCapacityUnits": 0}, token=admin, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "capacity_reserved", "cannot shrink below reserved")

    print()
    if failures:
        print(f"{len(failures)} FAILURE(S)")
        for f in failures:
            print(" -", f)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end API test for the Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery backend.

Runs against a live server (default http://127.0.0.1:8080) using the initial
administrator credentials from ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = []


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            status, payload = r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {status} (expected {expect}): {payload}")
        print(f"  FAIL {method} {path} -> {status} expected {expect}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        failures.append(msg)
        print("  FAIL", msg)
    else:
        print("  ok  ", msg)


def iso(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = p["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, token=tok, expect=200)
    return tok, p["data"]["userId"]


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    print("== readiness / auth")
    st, p = call("GET", "/ready", expect=200)
    check(p.get("status") == "ready", "ready endpoint")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "wrong"}, expect=401)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_credentials", "invalid credentials rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns admin role")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token="nope", expect=401)

    print("== sample types")
    st, snap = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-sample-type", {"name": f"Probe-{suffix}", "containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "qualifiedCollectorRequired": True, "requiredQualification": f"probe-{suffix}"}, token=admin, expect=201)
    probe_type = p["data"]["sampleTypeId"]
    check(p["data"]["batchingAllowed"] is True, "sample type defaults batchingAllowed")

    print("== network")
    def loc(name, lat, lon, fns, handling=5):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lon}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["locationId"]
    cp = loc(f"CP-{suffix}", 52.5200, 13.4050, ["collection_point"])
    hub = loc(f"Hub-{suffix}", 52.5300, 13.4200, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = loc(f"Lab-{suffix}", 52.5400, 13.4400, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = loc(f"Lab2-{suffix}", 52.5100, 13.3800, ["laboratory"])
    for rid in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": rid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
    def conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": 1, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, token=admin, expect=201)
        cid = p["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
        return cid
    c1 = conn(cp, hub, 20)
    c2 = conn(hub, lab, 20)
    c3 = conn(cp, lab2, 60)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab2, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, snap2 = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(snap2["data"]["version"] > snap["data"]["version"], "serviceability version advanced after network change")
    check(snap2["data"]["status"] == "complete", "snapshot is complete")

    print("== users")
    def user(name, roles, quals=None, assigned=None):
        body = {"username": f"{name}-{suffix}", "initialPassword": "pw12345", "fullName": name, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        if quals:
            body["qualifications"] = quals
            body["certifications"] = [{"code": q, "active": True} for q in quals]
        if assigned:
            body["assignedLocationId"] = assigned
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", body, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["userId"]
    req_id = user("requester", ["requester"])
    col_id = user("collector", ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], [f"probe-{suffix}"])
    cour_id = user("courier", ["delivery_partner"])
    cour2_id = user("courier2", ["delivery_partner"])
    cp_handler_id = user("cphandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=cp)
    hub_handler_id = user("hubhandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=hub)
    lab_op_id = user("labop", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab)
    lab2_op_id = user("lab2op", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab2)
    disp_id = user("dispatcher", ["dispatcher"])
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": f"requester-{suffix}", "initialPassword": "x", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, token=admin, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "username_exists", "duplicate username rejected")

    requester, _ = login(f"requester-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    collector, _ = login(f"collector-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=collector, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is True, "multi-role user must select a role")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_selected", "role_not_selected before selection")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, token=collector, expect=403)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_held", "cannot select unheld role")
    call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "collection_professional"}, token=collector, expect=200)
    courier, _ = login(f"courier-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    courier2, _ = login(f"courier2-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    cp_handler, _ = login(f"cphandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    hub_handler, _ = login(f"hubhandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    lab_op, _ = login(f"labop-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    dispatcher, _ = login(f"dispatcher-{suffix}", "pw12345")

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    deadline = now + timedelta(hours=6)
    body = {"origin": {"latitude": 52.5210, "longitude": 13.4060}, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(deadline)}
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", body, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is True and p["data"]["reason"] == "serviceable", "home near CP is serviceable")
    check(p["data"].get("targetLaboratoryId") == lab, "fastest lab chosen")
    far = dict(body, origin={"latitude": 53.9, "longitude": 10.0})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", far, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is False and p["data"]["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage", "far origin outside coverage")
    tight = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=10)))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", tight, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", "tight deadline unreachable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now - timedelta(hours=1))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_deadline", "deadline in the past rejected")
    st, before = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(len(before["data"]["pending"]) + len(before["data"]["inProgress"]) == 0, "dry run created nothing")

    print("== collection request")
    body.update({"containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "earliestCollectionAt": iso(now), "latestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=2))})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", body, token=requester, expect=201)
    sample_id = p["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = p["data"]["journeyId"]
    check(p["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable", "request serviceable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="bag"), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "handling_mismatch", "container mismatch rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, earliestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(hours=3))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_collection_window", "inverted collection window rejected")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["state"]["status"] == "requested", "sample requested")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
    plan = p["data"]
    check(plan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(plan["legs"]) == 3, f"3 transport legs, mode {plan['routeMode']}")
    check(len(plan["nodeAssignmentIds"]) == 2 and len(plan["laboratoryAssignmentIds"]) == 1, "node and lab assignments created")
    collection_asg = plan["collectionAssignmentId"]
    leg1, leg2, leg3 = [l["assignmentId"] for l in plan["legs"]]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check("legs" in p["data"] and "workerId" not in json.dumps(p["data"]["legs"]), "requester view hides workers")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=courier2, expect=403)

    print("== offers / accept / decline")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=collector, expect=200)
    check(any(w["assignmentId"] == collection_asg for w in p["data"]["pending"]), "collector sees offered collection")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=courier, expect=403)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg}, token=collector, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_required", "idempotency key required")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    st, p2 = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p == p2, "idempotent replay returns same result")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_conflict", "same key different body conflicts")
    st, w1 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier, expect=200)
    st, w2 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier2, expect=200)
    offered_c1 = [w["assignmentId"] for w in w1["data"]["pending"]]
    offered_c2 = [w["assignmentId"] for w in w2["data"]["pending"]]
    check(not (set(offered_c1) & set(offered_c2)), "an offer goes to one worker at a time")
    check(len(offered_c1) + len(offered_c2) >= 3, f"all legs offered ({len(offered_c1)}+{len(offered_c2)})")
    holder_of = {}
    for aid in (leg1, leg2, leg3):
        if aid in offered_c1:
            holder_of[aid] = (courier, cour_id)
        elif aid in offered_c2:
            holder_of[aid] = (courier2, cour2_id)
    tok, uid = holder_of[leg1]
    other_tok, other_uid = (courier2, cour2_id) if tok == courier else (courier, cour_id)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/decline-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "d1", "reason": "busy"}, token=tok, expect=201)
    check(p["data"].get("reofferedTo") == other_uid, "declined offer re-offered to next worker")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "a-leg1"}, token=tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "offer_not_offered", "decliner cannot accept re-offered work")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "a-leg1"}, token=other_tok, expect=201)
    leg1_tok, leg1_uid = other_tok, other_uid
    for aid in (leg2, leg3):
        tok, uid = holder_of[aid]
        call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": aid, "idempotencyKey": "a-" + aid}, token=tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    cp_asg = p["data"]["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    check(p["data"]["pending"][0]["nodeId"] == cp, "cp handler offered its node assignment")
    check("destinationCapacity" in p["data"]["pending"][0], "node work item shows capacity")
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": cp_asg, "idempotencyKey": "a-cp"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=hub_handler, expect=200)

    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=lab_op, expect=200)
    lab_asg = p["data"]["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]

    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": lab_asg, "idempotencyKey": "a-lab"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)

    print("== collection and sealing")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(now), "idempotencyKey": "pu-early"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "collection_required", "pickup before collection rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "collectedAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=3)), "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 4, "idempotencyKey": "c-late"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "outside_collection_window", "collection outside window rejected")
    t_collect = now + timedelta(minutes=5)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "collectedAt": iso(t_collect), "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 4, "idempotencyKey": "c1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "sealed" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sample sealed, collector holds it")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.521, "longitude": 13.406}, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, token=collector, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.521, "longitude": 13.406}, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, token=collector, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_sequence", "repeated location sequence rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": collection_asg, "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 5, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=1)), "idempotencyKey": "cp1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["compliant"] is True, "compliant checkpoint")

    print("== handoff collector -> courier")
    t = t_collect + timedelta(minutes=10)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": collection_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": holder_of[leg2][1], "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h-bad"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "nonadjacent_handoff", "skipping a leg is rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": collection_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg1, "receiverId": leg1_uid, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    h1 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sender still holds until both confirm")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1r"}, token=collector, expect=403)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1r"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "pending" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "one side confirmed: still pending")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1s"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "confirmed" and p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid, "both confirmed: courier holds")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h1s-again"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid, "repeated confirmation does not duplicate custody")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == leg1_uid and p["data"]["status"] == "in_transit", "lifecycle shows holder & status")

    print("== transport to CP, hub, lab")
    t += timedelta(minutes=15)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p1"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=5)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p2"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p3"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_transition", "backwards progress rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": hub_asg, "receiverId": hub_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h-wrongnode"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") in ("nonadjacent_handoff", "node_assignment_mismatch", "transport_leg_incomplete"), "handoff to wrong node rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": cp_asg, "receiverId": cp_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    h2 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2s"}, token=leg1_tok, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h2r"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id, "cp handler holds sample")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=leg1_tok, expect=200)
    check(any(w["assignmentId"] == leg1 for w in p["data"]["completed"]), "completed leg visible as past work")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=dispatcher, expect=200)
    smp = [s for s in p["data"]["samples"] if s["sampleId"] == sample_id][0]
    check(smp["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id, "operations state shows holder")
    t += timedelta(minutes=10)
    tok2, uid2 = holder_of[leg2]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": cp_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": uid2, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    h3 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3s"}, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h3r"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=20)
    call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "p4"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg2, "toAssignmentId": hub_asg, "receiverId": hub_handler_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    h4 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4s"}, token=tok2, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h4r"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": hub_asg, "locationId": hub, "containerType": "tube", "observedTemperatureC": 15, "recordedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "cp2"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["compliant"] is False and p["data"]["sampleStatus"] == "exception", "non-compliant checkpoint flags exception")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(p["data"].get("exception", {}).get("reason") == "handling_noncompliant", "lifecycle shows exception")
    t += timedelta(minutes=10)
    tok3, uid3 = holder_of[leg3]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": hub_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg3, "receiverId": uid3, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    h5 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h5, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5s"}, token=hub_handler, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h5, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h5r"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    t += timedelta(minutes=20)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r-early"}, token=lab_op, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "receipt_not_ready", "receipt before handoff rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg3, "toAssignmentId": lab_asg, "receiverId": lab_op_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    h6 = p["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h6, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6s"}, token=tok3, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h6, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "h6r"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab2, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r-wrong"}, token=lab_op, expect=403)
    check(p.get("code") == "wrong_laboratory_operator", "operator of another lab rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t), "idempotencyKey": "r1"}, token=lab_op, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "received", "sample received")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "completed", "journey completed")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=requester, expect=200)
    actions = [e["action"] for e in p["data"]["timeline"]]
    check("custody.transferred" in actions and "sample.received" in actions, "timeline has custody and receipt")
    check(all(p["data"]["timeline"][i]["eventId"] < p["data"]["timeline"][i + 1]["eventId"] for i in range(len(actions) - 1)), "timeline ordered")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    labloc = [l for l in p["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == lab][0]
    check(labloc["capacity"]["reservedUnits"] == 0, "capacity released after receipt")

    print("== audit")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample_id, "limit": 10, "order": "oldest_first"}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["total"] > 10 and p["data"]["hasMore"] is True and p["data"]["returned"] == 10, "audit search pages")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"action": "auth.login"}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["total"] >= 5, "sign-ins audited")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"limit": 0}, token=admin, expect=400)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {}, token=requester, expect=403)

    print("== pre-sealed registration at a node")
    body2 = dict(body, originType="node", originNodeId=cp, origin={"latitude": 52.52, "longitude": 13.405}, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(hours=8)))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/ingest-presealed-sample", body2, token=hub_handler, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_holder", "node handler must register at own node")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/ingest-presealed-sample", body2, token=cp_handler, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["alreadySealed"] is True, "presealed registered")
    ps_id, ps_j = p["data"]["sampleId"], p["data"]["journeyId"]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": ps_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(len(p["data"]["legs"]) == 2 and not p["data"]["collectionAssignmentIds"], "presealed journey has only onward legs")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": ps_id}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id and p["data"]["sealed"], "registrant holds presealed sample")

    print("== dispatcher: reroute / disruption / cancel / plan versions")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/reroute-journey", {"journeyId": ps_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 99, "idempotencyKey": "rr0"}, token=dispatcher, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "stale_plan", "stale plan version rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/reroute-journey", {"journeyId": ps_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "idempotencyKey": "rr1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["replanStatus"] == "not_required", "reroute with unchanged network not required")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/report-disruption", {"resourceType": "node", "resourceId": hub, "occurredAt": iso(t), "reason": "flood", "idempotencyKey": "dis1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["replanStatus"] == "replaced" and ps_id in p["data"]["affectedSampleIds"], f"hub disruption replans: {p['data']['replanStatus']}")
    new_j = p["data"]["replacementPlanIds"][0] if p["data"]["replacementPlanIds"] else None
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": new_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"].get("parentJourneyId") == ps_j and p["data"]["legs"][0]["toLocationId"] == lab2, "replacement journey goes to lab2")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": ps_id}, token=cp_handler, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["currentHolderId"] == cp_handler_id and p["data"]["activeJourneyId"] == new_j, "holder unchanged after replanning")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": ps_j}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "replaced" and p["data"].get("replacementJourney", {}).get("journeyId") == new_j, "old journey marked replaced")
    call("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {"locationId": hub, "active": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/cancel-journey", {"journeyId": new_j, "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "idempotencyKey": "cx1", "reason": "test"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["status"] == "cancelled", "journey cancelled")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{ps_id}", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["state"]["status"] == "cancelled", "sample cancelled")

    print("== merge / split")
    reqs = []
    for i in range(2):
        b = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(hours=8)))
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", b, token=requester, expect=201)
        reqs.append((p["data"]["sampleId"], p["data"]["journeyId"]))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/merge-journeys", {"targetJourneyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "sourceJourneyIds": [reqs[1][1]], "idempotencyKey": "m1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"].get("routeMode") == "batched" and set(p["data"].get("sampleIds", [])) == {reqs[0][0], reqs[1][0]}, "journeys merged into a batch")
    merged_version = p["data"].get("planVersion", 2)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/split-journey", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version, "sampleIds": [reqs[1][0]], "idempotencyKey": "s1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(p["data"]["splitJourney"]["sampleIds"] == [reqs[1][0]] and p["data"]["journey"]["sampleIds"] == [reqs[0][0]], "batch split back apart")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/edit-active-plan", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version + 1, "changeType": "remove_stop", "changes": {"stopId": "nope"}, "idempotencyKey": "e1"}, token=dispatcher, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_stop", "invalid stop edit rejected and plan kept")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/edit-active-plan", {"journeyId": reqs[0][1], "expectedPlanVersion": merged_version + 1, "changeType": "bogus", "changes": {}, "idempotencyKey": "e2"}, token=dispatcher, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_change_type", "invalid change type rejected")

    print("== events")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/events?since=0", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["cursor"] > 0 and len(p["data"]["events"]) > 0, "events replay via since cursor")

    print("== capacity guard")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cp, "capacityUnits": 0, "cooledCapacityUnits": 0}, token=admin, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "capacity_reserved", "cannot shrink below reserved")

    print()
    if failures:
        print(f"{len(failures)} FAILURE(S)")
        for f in failures:
            print(" -", f)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end API test for the Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery backend.

Runs against a live server (default http://127.0.0.1:8080) using the initial
administrator credentials from ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = []


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            status, payload = r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {status} (expected {expect}): {payload}")
        print(f"  FAIL {method} {path} -> {status} expected {expect}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        failures.append(msg)
        print("  FAIL", msg)
    else:
        print("  ok  ", msg)


def iso(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = p["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, token=tok, expect=200)
    return tok, p["data"]["userId"]


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    print("== readiness / auth")
    st, p = call("GET", "/ready", expect=200)
    check(p.get("status") == "ready", "ready endpoint")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "wrong"}, expect=401)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_credentials", "invalid credentials rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns admin role")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token="nope", expect=401)

    print("== sample types")
    st, snap = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-sample-type", {"name": f"Probe-{suffix}", "containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "qualifiedCollectorRequired": True, "requiredQualification": f"probe-{suffix}"}, token=admin, expect=201)
    probe_type = p["data"]["sampleTypeId"]
    check(p["data"]["batchingAllowed"] is True, "sample type defaults batchingAllowed")

    print("== network")
    def loc(name, lat, lon, fns, handling=5):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lon}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["locationId"]
    cp = loc(f"CP-{suffix}", 52.5200, 13.4050, ["collection_point"])
    hub = loc(f"Hub-{suffix}", 52.5300, 13.4200, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = loc(f"Lab-{suffix}", 52.5400, 13.4400, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = loc(f"Lab2-{suffix}", 52.5100, 13.3800, ["laboratory"])
    for rid in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": rid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
    def conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": 1, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, token=admin, expect=201)
        cid = p["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
        return cid
    c1 = conn(cp, hub, 20)
    c2 = conn(hub, lab, 20)
    c3 = conn(cp, lab2, 60)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab2, "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)
    st, snap2 = call("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, token=admin, expect=200)
    check(snap2["data"]["version"] > snap["data"]["version"], "serviceability version advanced after network change")
    check(snap2["data"]["status"] == "complete", "snapshot is complete")

    print("== users")

        if quals:
            body["qualifications"] = quals
            body["certifications"] = [{"code": q, "active": True} for q in quals]
        if assigned:
            body["assignedLocationId"] = assigned
        st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", body, token=admin, expect=201)
        return p["data"]["userId"]
    req_id = user("requester", ["requester"])
    col_id = user("collector", ["collection_professional"], [f"probe-{suffix}"])
    multi_id = user("multi", ["dispatcher", "requester"])
    cour_id = user("courier", ["delivery_partner"])
    cour2_id = user("courier2", ["delivery_partner"])
    cp_handler_id = user("cphandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=cp)
    hub_handler_id = user("hubhandler", ["node_handler"], assigned=hub)
    lab_op_id = user("labop", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab)
    lab2_op_id = user("lab2op", ["laboratory_team"], assigned=lab2)
    disp_id = user("dispatcher", ["dispatcher"])
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": f"requester-{suffix}", "initialPassword": "x", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, token=admin, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "username_exists", "duplicate username rejected")

    requester, _ = login(f"requester-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    collector, _ = login(f"collector-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    multi, _ = login(f"multi-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    st, p = call("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=multi, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is True, "multi-role user must select a role")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=multi, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_selected", "role_not_selected before selection")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, token=multi, expect=403)
    check(p.get("code") == "role_not_held", "cannot select unheld role")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "requester"}, token=multi, expect=200)
    check(set(p["data"]["roles"]) == {"dispatcher", "requester"}, "role switch keeps roles")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=multi, expect=403)
    call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "dispatcher"}, token=multi, expect=200)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, token=multi, expect=200)
    check("samples" in p.get("data", {}), "permissions follow the selected role")
    courier, _ = login(f"courier-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    courier2, _ = login(f"courier2-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    cp_handler, _ = login(f"cphandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    hub_handler, _ = login(f"hubhandler-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    lab_op, _ = login(f"labop-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    dispatcher, _ = login(f"dispatcher-{suffix}", "pw12345")

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    deadline = now + timedelta(hours=6)
    body = {"origin": {"latitude": 52.5210, "longitude": 13.4060}, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": probe_type, "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(deadline)}
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", body, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is True and p["data"]["reason"] == "serviceable", "home near CP is serviceable")
    check(p["data"].get("targetLaboratoryId") == lab, "fastest lab chosen")
    far = dict(body, origin={"latitude": 53.9, "longitude": 10.0})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", far, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["serviceable"] is False and p["data"]["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage", "far origin outside coverage")
    tight = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=10)))
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", tight, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", "tight deadline unreachable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now - timedelta(hours=1))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_deadline", "deadline in the past rejected")
    st, before = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check(len(before["data"]["pending"]) + len(before["data"]["inProgress"]) == 0, "dry run created nothing")

    print("== collection request")
    body.update({"containerType": "tube", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 8, "earliestCollectionAt": iso(now), "latestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=2))})
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", body, token=requester, expect=201)
    sample_id = p["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = p["data"]["journeyId"]
    check(p["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable", "request serviceable")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="bag"), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "handling_mismatch", "container mismatch rejected")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, earliestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(hours=3))), token=requester, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "invalid_collection_window", "inverted collection window rejected")
    st, p = call("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(p["data"]["state"]["status"] == "requested", "sample requested")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
    plan = p["data"]
    check(plan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(plan["legs"]) == 3, f"3 transport legs, mode {plan['routeMode']}")
    check(len(plan["nodeAssignmentIds"]) == 2 and len(plan["laboratoryAssignmentIds"]) == 1, "node and lab assignments created")
    collection_asg = plan["collectionAssignmentId"]
    leg1, leg2, leg3 = [l["assignmentId"] for l in plan["legs"]]
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=requester, expect=200)
    check("legs" in p["data"] and "workerId" not in json.dumps(p["data"]["legs"]), "requester view hides workers")
    lab2_op, _ = login(f"lab2op-{suffix}", "pw12345")

    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)

    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "a-leg1"}, token=other_tok, expect=201)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end API test for the Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery backend.

Runs against a live server (default http://127.0.0.1:8080) using the initial
administrator credentials from ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = []


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            status, payload = r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {status} (expected {expect}): {payload}")
        print(f"  FAIL {method} {path} -> {status} expected {expect}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        failures.append(msg)
        print("  FAIL", msg)
    else:
        print("  ok  ", msg)


def iso(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = p["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, token=tok, expect=200)
    return tok, p["data"]["userId"]

    st, p = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", dict(body, earliestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(hours=3))), token=requester, expect=400)

    lab2_op, _ = login(f"lab2op-{suffix}", "pw12345")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=lab2_op, expect=403)

    print("== offers / accept / decline")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=collector, expect=200)

    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=courier, expect=403)
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg}, token=collector, expect=400)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_required", "idempotency key required")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    st, p2 = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": collection_asg, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=201)
    check(p == p2, "idempotent replay returns same result")
    st, p = call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": "k1"}, token=collector, expect=409)
    check(p.get("code") == "idempotency_conflict", "same key different body conflicts")
    st, w1 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier, expect=200)
    st, w2 = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, token=courier2, expect=200)
